title: O‘tgan zamon: muntazam fe’llar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida muntazam fe’llardan o‘tgan zamon shaklini to‘g‘ri yasaysiz va ed oxirini t, d yoki id deb o‘qiysiz, yesterday, last week, ago bilan gap tuzasiz, didn’t bilan inkor gap va did bilan savol hosil qilasiz.

scenes.title: O‘tgan zamon: muntazam fe’llar
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yangi bosqich, A2 ning birinchi darsiga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda A1 darajani takrorlab, imtihon topshirdik. Endigacha ko‘proq hozirgi zamonda gapirdik. Bugun o‘tmish haqida gapirishni boshlaymiz: kecha nima qildingiz, o‘tgan hafta qayerda bo‘ldingiz. Dars oxirida muntazam fe’llar bilan o‘tgan zamonda gap, inkor va savol tuza olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello and welcome to level A2. Today we talk about the past.
scenes.say_uz: Salom va A2 darajasiga xush kelibsiz. Bugun o‘tmish haqida gaplashamiz.

scenes.title: Past Simple nima uchun kerak?

examples.uz: U kecha kechqurun menga qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.

scenes.say_native: Past Simple tugagan o‘tmish ishni bildiradi: ish o‘tmishda boshlangan va tugagan. Odatda qachon bo‘lgani aytiladi: kecha, o‘tgan hafta, ikki yil oldin. O‘zbekchada bu “ishladim”, “qo‘ng‘iroq qildi” kabi fe’llarga to‘g‘ri keladi. Inglizchada ko‘pgina fe’llarning o‘tgan zamon shakli oddiy qoida bilan yasaladi. Shunday fe’llar muntazam, ya’ni regular verbs deyiladi.
scenes.say: I worked yesterday. She called me last night.
scenes.say_uz: Men kecha ishladim. U kecha kechqurun menga qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.

scenes.title: Asosiy qoida: fe’l + ed
board: I, you, he, she, we, they + worked
scenes.say_native: Asosiy qoida oddiy: fe’lga ed qo‘shamiz. Work — worked, play — played, clean — cleaned, watch — watched. Eng yaxshi tomoni: hamma shaxsga shakl bir xil. I worked, you worked, she worked, they worked. Hozirgi zamondagi she works dagi s o‘tgan zamonda yo‘qoladi. O‘zbekchada fe’lga shaxs qo‘shimchasi qo‘shiladi: ishladim, ishladingiz, inglizchada bu kerak emas.
scenes.say: I worked. You worked. She worked. They worked.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishladim. Siz ishladingiz. U ishladi. Ular ishladi.

scenes.title: E bilan tugasa: faqat d
scenes.say_native: Birinchi imlo qoidasi. Fe’l e harfi bilan tugasa, ikkinchi e kerak emas, faqat d qo‘shamiz. Like — liked, live — lived, dance — danced, arrive — arrived. Hech qachon “likeed” yozmang. Bu qoida juda oddiy, ammo yozma ishlarda aynan shu yerda xato ko‘p bo‘ladi. Odat bo‘lib qolsin: e bor bo‘lsa, faqat d.
scenes.say: I liked the film. We lived in Bukhara.
scenes.say_uz: Menga film yoqdi. Biz Buxoroda yashadik.

scenes.title: Y bilan tugasa
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi qoida: y bilan tugaydigan fe’llar. Agar y dan oldin undosh bo‘lsa, y ni i ga almashtirib, ed qo‘shamiz: study — studied, cry — cried, try — tried. Agar y dan oldin unli bo‘lsa, hech narsani o‘zgartirmaymiz: play — played, enjoy — enjoyed, stay — stayed. Qisqa tekshiruv: y dan oldin nima turibdi, undoshmi yoki unli?
scenes.say: I studied English. We played football.
scenes.say_uz: Men ingliz tilini o‘rgandim. Biz futbol o‘ynadik.

scenes.title: Undosh ikkilanishi

examples.t: The taxi stopped at the hotel.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi qoida: qisqa fe’llarda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi. Stop — stopped, plan — planned. Bu faqat bir bo‘g‘inli va unli plus undosh bilan tugaydigan fe’llarga tegishli. Ko‘p bo‘g‘inli fe’llarda urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda bo‘lsa, ikkilanmaydi: visit — visited, open — opened. W, x, y ikkilanmaydi: show — showed. Britaniyada travel — travelled, Amerikada traveled.
scenes.say: The bus stopped. We planned a trip.
scenes.say_uz: Avtobus to‘xtadi. Biz sayohat rejalashtirdik.

scenes.title: Imlo xatolari
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan imlo xatolari. Birinchisi: studyed, to‘g‘risi studied. Ikkinchisi: stoped, to‘g‘risi stopped, undosh ikkilanishi kerak. Uchinchisi: likeed, to‘g‘risi liked. To‘rtinchisi esa teskari xato: visitted. Bu yerda ikkilanish yo‘q, chunki urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Qoidalarni bilsangiz, har bir fe’lni alohida yodlash shart emas.
scenes.say: Studied. Stopped. Liked. Visited.
scenes.say_uz: O‘rgandi. To‘xtadi. Yoqtirdi. Ko‘rgani bordi.

scenes.title: O‘tgan zamon shaklini yozing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Oltita fe’lning o‘tgan zamon shaklini ayting va harflab chiqing. Birinchi: like. Ikkinchi: study. Uchinchi: stop. To‘rtinchi: play. Beshinchi: cry. Oltinchi: visit. Qoidani eslang: e, y yoki ikkilanish bormi? To‘liq gap bilan javob berishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Say the past form. One. Like. Two. Study. Three. Stop. Four. Play. Five. Cry. Six. Visit.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan zamon shaklini ayting. Bir. Like. Ikki. Study. Uch. Stop. To‘rt. Play. Besh. Cry. Olti. Visit.

scenes.title: Javoblar: shakllar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Like — liked, faqat d. Study — studied, y undoshdan keyin i ga o‘zgaradi. Stop — stopped, undosh ikkilanadi. Play — played, y unlidan keyin o‘zgarmaydi. Cry — cried, y undoshdan keyin. Visit — visited, ikkilanish yo‘q. Oltitadan beshtasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, imlo qoidalarini yaxshi o‘zlashtirgansiz.
scenes.say: Liked. Studied. Stopped. Played. Cried. Visited.
scenes.say_uz: Liked. Studied. Stopped. Played. Cried. Visited.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ed ning uch tovushi
scenes.say_native: Endi talaffuz, bu juda muhim. Ed oxiri uch xil o‘qiladi. Jarangsiz tovushdan keyin t: worked, stopped, watched, washed. Jarangli tovushdan va unlidan keyin d: played, cleaned, lived, called. Faqat t yoki d tovushidan keyin ɪd: wanted, needed, decided. Bunda qo‘shimcha bo‘g‘in paydo bo‘ladi. Qolgan ikki holatda yangi bo‘g‘in qo‘shilmaydi: worked bitta bo‘g‘in.
scenes.say: Worked. Played. Wanted.
scenes.say_uz: Worked. Played. Wanted.

scenes.title: Qanday farqlash mumkin?
board: jarangsiz: p k f s sh ch → /t/
scenes.say_native: Qanday farqlaymiz? Gapirayotganda tomog‘ingizga qo‘lingizni qo‘ying. Jarangsiz tovushlar, p, k, f, s, sh, ch da bo‘g‘iz titramaydi, shuning uchun oxirida t. Jarangli tovushlar va unlilarda bo‘g‘iz titraydi, shuning uchun d. Faqat t va d dan keyin yengil “id”. Misollar: laughed, jumped — t. Opened, listened — d. Started, decided — id.
scenes.say: Watched. Cleaned. Started.
scenes.say_uz: Watched. Cleaned. Started.

scenes.title: Talaffuz xatolari
scenes.say_native: Eng katta xato: har bir ed ni “ed” deb alohida o‘qish. “Work-ed”, “play-ed”, “like-ed” — noto‘g‘ri. Worked, played, liked bitta bo‘g‘in. Faqat wanted, needed, started, decided kabi t yoki d bilan tugaydigan fe’llarda ikkita bo‘g‘in bor. Bu qoida yodlash uchun emas, quloq bilan o‘rganiladi, shuning uchun hozir baland ovozda takrorlaymiz.
scenes.say: Worked, not work-ed. Wanted, two syllables.
scenes.say_uz: Worked, work-ed emas. Wanted, ikkita bo‘g‘in.

scenes.title: Tovushlarni guruhlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Oltita so‘zni o‘qing va ed oxirini qaysi tovush bilan aytishingizni ayting: t, d yoki id. Worked, played, wanted, watched, cleaned, needed. Har bir so‘zdan oldin oxirgi tovushni o‘ylang: jarangsizmi, jarangli yoki t, d. Diqqat bilan va xotirjam bajaring, vaqt yetarli.
scenes.say: Say each word. Worked. Played. Wanted. Watched. Cleaned. Needed.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir so‘zni ayting. Worked. Played. Wanted. Watched. Cleaned. Needed.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tovushlar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Worked va watched — t, chunki k va ch jarangsiz. Played va cleaned — d, chunki y va n jarangli. Wanted va needed — id, chunki t va d bilan tugagan. Agar barchasini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, talaffuz qismi tayyor. Shunga qaramay, har gal yangi fe’lni o‘qiyotganda ed ga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Worked, watched. Played, cleaned. Wanted, needed.
scenes.say_uz: Worked, watched. Played, cleaned. Wanted, needed.

scenes.title: Vaqt so‘zlari 1: yesterday, last
board: last night, last week, last year

examples.t: Last year we travelled to Turkey.
examples.uz: O‘tgan yil biz Turkiyaga sayohat qildik.

scenes.say_native: Endi vaqt so‘zlari. Past Simple bilan ko‘pincha quyidagilar keladi. Yesterday — kecha, yesterday morning — kecha ertalab. Last night — kecha kechqurun, last week — o‘tgan hafta, last month — o‘tgan oy, last year — o‘tgan yil. Muhim: last dan oldin in yoki on kerak emas. Bu yerda predlog yo‘q. Gap boshida ham, oxirida ham kelishi mumkin.
scenes.say: I called him yesterday. Last week we visited Tashkent.
scenes.say_uz: Men unga kecha qo‘ng‘iroq qildim. O‘tgan hafta Toshkentga bordik.

scenes.title: Vaqt so‘zlari 2: ago, in, on
board: two days ago, ten years ago

examples.t: She started work two weeks ago.
examples.uz: U ishni ikki hafta oldin boshladi.
Men unga dushanba kuni qo‘ng‘iroq qildim.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi to‘plam. Ago — oldin, u davr o‘lchovidan keyin keladi: two days ago, three years ago. O‘zbekchada “ikki kun oldin”, “oldin” ham shu o‘rinda. Aniq vaqt uchun predlog: in 2019, in June, on Monday, on the fifth of May. Savol: When did you arrive? Javob: I arrived two hours ago. Ago hamisha o‘tgan zamon bilan ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: I arrived two hours ago. We moved in 2019.
scenes.say_uz: Men ikki soat oldin yetib keldim. Biz 2019 yilda ko‘chib o‘tdik.

scenes.title: Vaqt so‘zlaridagi xatolar
board: ✗ before two days → ✓ two days ago
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchi: “before two days”, to‘g‘risi “two days ago”. Ago so‘zi davrdan keyin keladi, oldin emas. Ikkinchi: “in last week”, chunki o‘zbekchada ko‘pincha “o‘tgan hafta ichida” deymiz. Inglizchada predlog kerak emas: last week. Uchinchi: “at yesterday”. Yesterday predlogsiz ishlatiladi. Esda tuting: last, yesterday, ago bilan predlog yo‘q.
scenes.say: Two days ago. Last week. Yesterday.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki kun oldin. O‘tgan hafta. Kecha.

scenes.title: Gapni o‘tgan zamonga o‘tkazing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Hozirgi zamondagi gaplarni o‘tgan zamonga o‘tkazing va berilgan vaqt so‘zini qo‘shing. Birinchi: I walk to work, yesterday. Ikkinchi: she cooks dinner, last night. Uchinchi: they visit us, two weeks ago. Fe’lga ed qo‘shishni unutmang, she cooks dagi s esa tushib qoladi.
scenes.say: Change to the past. One. I walk to work, yesterday. Two. She cooks dinner, last night. Three. They visit us, two weeks ago.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan zamonga o‘tkazing. Bir. Men ishga piyoda boraman, kecha. Ikki. U kechki ovqat pishiradi, kecha kechqurun. Uch. Ular bizni ko‘rgani keladi, ikki hafta oldin.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) They visited us two weeks ago.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: I walked to work yesterday. Ikkinchi: she cooked dinner last night. Uchinchisi: they visited us two weeks ago. E’tibor bering: she cooks dagi s yo‘qoldi, cooked bo‘ldi. Ago ni davrdan keyin qo‘ydingizmi? Yaxshi. Vaqt so‘zini gap boshiga olib o‘tsangiz ham to‘g‘ri: Yesterday I walked to work.
scenes.say: I walked to work yesterday. She cooked dinner last night. They visited us two weeks ago.
scenes.say_uz: Men kecha ishga piyoda bordim. U kecha kechqurun kechki ovqat pishirdi. Ular bizni ikki hafta oldin ko‘rgani kelishdi.

scenes.title: Inkor: didn’t + fe’l
scenes.say_native: Endi inkor. Qoida: didn’t va undan keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli. I worked — I didn’t work. She called — she didn’t call. Didn’t yagona, hamma shaxsga bir xil. Eng muhim narsa: o‘tgan zamon belgisi did ichida qoladi, asosiy fe’lga ed qo‘shilmaydi. Did not ham to‘g‘ri, ammo suhbatda odatda qisqa shakl didn’t aytiladi.
scenes.say: I didn't work yesterday. She didn't call me.
scenes.say_uz: Men kecha ishlamadim. U menga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmadi.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tili bilan taqqos
scenes.say_native: Taqqoslang. O‘zbekchada “ishlamadim” bitta so‘z: ishla, ma bu inkor, di bu o‘tgan zamon. Inglizchada bu uch qism ajraladi: did o‘tmishni bildiradi, not inkorni, work esa asosiy fe’l. O‘tmish belgisi bitta joyda bo‘ladi, shuning uchun fe’lga yana ed qo‘shsangiz, ikki marta o‘tgan zamon bo‘ladi. Aynan shu sabab didn’t worked noto‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: I didn't work. Did marks the past.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishlamadim. Did o‘tmishni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Inkordagi xatolar
board: ✗ I didn't worked → ✓ I didn't work
✗ I no worked → ✓ I didn't work
✗ She didn't liked → ✓ She didn't like
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchi: “I didn’t worked”. To‘g‘risi: I didn’t work. Ikkinchi: “I no worked”, inglizchada no bilan fe’l inkor qilinmaydi. To‘g‘risi: I didn’t work. Uchinchi: “She didn’t liked”. To‘g‘risi: she didn’t like. Qoida bitta: didn’t dan keyin faqat oddiy fe’l, hech qanday ed, hech qanday s.
scenes.say: I didn't work. She didn't like it.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishlamadim. Unga yoqmadi.

scenes.title: Inkor gap tuzing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta darak gapni inkorga aylantiring. Birinchi: she watched TV. Ikkinchi: we cleaned the room. Uchinchi: I called him. To‘rtinchi: they worked on Sunday. Didn’t dan keyin fe’lni oddiy shaklga qaytaring. Har bir javobni ohang bilan, tabiiy ayting.
scenes.say: Make negative sentences. One. She watched TV. Two. We cleaned the room. Three. I called him. Four. They worked on Sunday.
scenes.say_uz: Inkor gaplar tuzing. Bir. U televizor ko‘rdi. Ikki. Biz xonani tozaladik. Uch. Men unga qo‘ng‘iroq qildim. To‘rt. Ular yakshanba kuni ishladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: inkor
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: she didn’t watch TV. Ikkinchi: we didn’t clean the room. Uchinchi: I didn’t call him. To‘rtinchi: they didn’t work on Sunday. Har birida didn’t dan keyin oddiy fe’l, watch, clean, call, work. Agar “ed” qo‘shgan bo‘lsangiz, bu eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato, endi ongli ravishda tuzatamiz.
scenes.say: She didn't watch TV. We didn't clean the room. I didn't call him. They didn't work on Sunday.
scenes.say_uz: U televizor ko‘rmadi. Biz xonani tozalamadik. Men unga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmadim. Ular yakshanba kuni ishlamadi.

scenes.title: Ha/yo‘q savollari
board: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
scenes.say_native: Savol tuzish oson: Did, keyin ega, keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli. Did you watch TV? Did she call you? Did they arrive late? Javobda fe’lni takrorlamaymiz: Yes, I did. No, I didn’t. Did bu yerda yordamchi fe’l, o‘tmish belgisi. Shu sababli asosiy fe’l o‘zgarmaydi. Gap oxirida ovoz ko‘tarilib, savol ohangini beradi.
scenes.say: Did you watch TV? Yes, I did. No, I didn't.
scenes.say_uz: Siz televizor ko‘rdingizmi? Ha. Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Savol so‘zi bilan
scenes.say_native: Savol so‘zlari bilan tartib: savol so‘zi, did, ega, oddiy fe’l. What did you do? Where did she live? What time did they arrive? Why did you stop? How did you travel? Birinchi so‘z — what, where, when, why yoki how. Keyin did. Fe’lga ed qo‘shilmaydi. Bu tartibni o‘zbekchadagi savol tuzilishi bilan solishtirmang, chunki u yerda savol faqat ohang va qo‘shimcha bilan beriladi.
scenes.say: Where did she live? What time did they arrive?
scenes.say_uz: U qayerda yashagan? Ular soat nechada yetib kelishdi?

scenes.title: Savoldagi xatolar
board: ✗ Did you watched? → ✓ Did you watch?
✗ Where you worked? → ✓ Where did you work?
✗ What did you cooked? → ✓ What did you cook?
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “Did you watched”, to‘g‘risi did you watch. Ikkinchisi: did ni tushirib qoldirish, “Where you worked”. To‘g‘risi: where did you work. Uchinchisi: “What did you cooked”, to‘g‘risi what did you cook. Eslab qoling: savolda ham, inkorda ham o‘tgan zamon belgisi did da, fe’lga ed faqat darak gapda qo‘shiladi.
scenes.say: Did you watch? Where did you work? What did you cook?
scenes.say_uz: Siz ko‘rdingizmi? Qayerda ishladingiz? Nima pishirdingiz?

scenes.title: Savol tuzing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Darak gaplardan savol tuzing. Birinchi: you played football, ha yoki yo‘q savoli. Ikkinchi: she lived in London, ha yoki yo‘q savoli. Uchinchi: they arrived at ten, what time bilan boshlang. To‘rtinchi: you cooked pasta, what bilan boshlang. Ed ni tashlab, did qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Make questions. One. You played football. Two. She lived in London. Three. They arrived at ten. Four. You cooked pasta.
scenes.say_uz: Savollar tuzing. Bir. Siz futbol o‘ynadingiz. Ikki. U Londonda yashadi. Uch. Ular o‘nda yetib kelishdi. To‘rt. Siz makaron pishirdingiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar: savollar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: did you play football. Ikkinchi: did she live in London. Uchinchi: what time did they arrive. To‘rtinchi: what did you cook, javobi pasta bo‘ladi. Har safar did, ega, oddiy fe’l tartibini ko‘rdingiz. Bu tartib hozirgi zamondagi do va does bilan bir xil, faqat endi hamma shaxsga did.
scenes.say: Did you play football? Did she live in London? What time did they arrive? What did you cook?
scenes.say_uz: Siz futbol o‘ynadingizmi? U Londonda yashadimi? Ular soat nechada yetib kelishdi? Siz nima pishirdingiz?

scenes.title: Dialog 1: dam olish kunlari
board: Tom: What did you do at the weekend?
Mia: I cleaned the flat and cooked dinner.
Tom: Did you visit your sister?
Mia: No, I didn't. I called her.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Dushanba kuni ertalab ikki hamkasb, Tom va Mia, dam olish kunlari haqida gaplashadi. Ular o‘tgan zamon fe’llarini, inkorni va savollarni ishlatadi. Kim nima qilganiga e’tibor bering va qaysi fe’llar ed bilan tugashini sanang.
scenes.say: Hi, Mia. What did you do at the weekend? On Saturday I cleaned the flat and cooked dinner. Then I watched a film. Did you visit your sister? No, I didn't. I called her, but she worked all day. I played football on Sunday. We started at ten and finished at twelve. Did you enjoy it? Yes, I did.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Mia. Dam olish kunlari nima qildingiz? Shanba kuni kvartirani tozaladim va kechki ovqat pishirdim. Keyin film ko‘rdim. Singlingizni ko‘rgani bordingizmi? Yo‘q. Unga qo‘ng‘iroq qildim, lekin u kun bo‘yi ishladi. Yakshanba kuni futbol o‘ynadim. O‘nda boshlab, o‘n ikkida tugatdik. Zavqlandingizmi? Ha.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: savollar
board: 3) Did she visit her sister? Why not?
4) What time did the football start?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Mia nimani tozaladi? Ikkinchi: u nimani ko‘rdi? Uchinchi: u singlisini ko‘rgani bordimi, nega yo‘q? To‘rtinchi: futbol soat nechada boshlandi? Javobni o‘tgan zamonda to‘liq gap bilan bering. Mashqni kamida bir marta to‘liq bajaring, keyin o‘tamiz.
scenes.say: One. What did Mia clean? Two. What did she watch? Three. Did she visit her sister? Why not? Four. What time did the football start?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Mia nimani tozaladi? Ikki. U nimani ko‘rdi? Uch. U singlisini ko‘rgani bordimi? Nega yo‘q? To‘rt. Futbol soat nechada boshlandi?

scenes.title: Dialog 1: javoblar
board: 3) No, she didn't. Her sister worked all day.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Mia kvartirani tozaladi: she cleaned the flat. U film ko‘rdi: she watched a film. Singlisini ko‘rgani bormadi: no, she didn’t, chunki singlisi kun bo‘yi ishladi. Futbol soat o‘nda boshlandi: it started at ten. Dialogda cleaned, cooked, watched, called, worked, played, started, finished, enjoyed fe’llari bor. Bu to‘qqiz regular fe’l!
scenes.say: She cleaned the flat. She watched a film. No, she didn't. It started at ten.
scenes.say_uz: U kvartirani tozaladi. U film ko‘rdi. Yo‘q. U o‘nda boshlandi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: Samarqand safari
board: Dana: Did you travel to Samarkand?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Dana do‘sti Ravshandan so‘raydi: nega kecha qo‘ng‘iroqqa javob bermading, Samarqandga bording? Ravshan javob beradi. Diqqat qiling: vaqt so‘zlari, ago va yesterday, shuningdek, did bilan savollar. Birinchi marta umumiy ma’noni tushuning.
scenes.say: Ravshan, I called you yesterday, but you didn't answer. Sorry! I worked late and then I walked home. Did you travel to Samarkand last month? Yes, I travelled there three weeks ago with my cousin. We visited the Registan and stayed in a small hotel. Did you like the food? Yes, we enjoyed it a lot.
scenes.say_uz: Ravshan, kecha senga qo‘ng‘iroq qildim, lekin sen javob bermading. Kechir! Kech ishladim, keyin uyga piyoda bordim. O‘tgan oy Samarqandga bording? Ha, uch hafta oldin amakivachcham bilan bordim. Registonni ko‘rdik va kichik mehmonxonada qoldik. Taom yoqdimi? Ha, juda zavqlandik.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: savollar
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Ravshan nega javob bermadi? Ikkinchi: u qachon sayohat qildi? Uchinchi: u kim bilan bordi? To‘rtinchi: ular nimani ko‘rishdi? Bu yerda javob dialogda aynan bor, uni toping va to‘liq gap bilan ayting. O‘zingizni sinab ko‘ring, bu juda foydali bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: One. Why didn't Ravshan answer? Two. When did he travel? Three. Who did he travel with? Four. What did they visit?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Ravshan nega javob bermadi? Ikki. U qachon sayohat qildi? Uch. U kim bilan sayohat qildi? To‘rt. Ular nimani ko‘rishdi?

scenes.title: Dialog 2: javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. U kech ishladi va keyin uyga piyoda bordi: he worked late. U uch hafta oldin sayohat qildi: three weeks ago. Amakivachchasi bilan: with his cousin. Ular Registonni ko‘rishdi: they visited the Registan. Dialogda Ravshan “travelled” dedi, bu Britaniya imlosi, bitta l ikkita ll. Amerikada bitta l ham ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: He worked late. Three weeks ago. With his cousin. They visited the Registan.
scenes.say_uz: U kech ishladi. Uch hafta oldin. Amakivachchasi bilan. Ular Registonni ko‘rishdi.

scenes.title: Tez gapirganda: Did you…?
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda did you tez aytilganda birlashadi, “didja” kabi eshitiladi. Savol: “Did you like it?” — “didja like it”. Didn’t esa ikkita bo‘g‘in, “did-nt”, oxirgi t juda yengil. What did you do — “whaddya do”. Siz bunday tez shaklni majburan aytishingiz shart emas, ammo shuni eshitsangiz tushunishingiz kerak. Sekin, aniq gapirish ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Did you like it? What did you do?
scenes.say_uz: Sizga yoqdimi? Siz nima qildingiz?

scenes.title: Ritm bilan takrorlang
board: What did you do last night?
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Muhim so‘zlarni kuchliroq ayting: did you LIKE it? I didn’t WORK yesterday. What did you DO last night? Ed li fe’llarda oxirgi tovushni unutmang: liked, worked. Avval sekin, keyin tezroq takrorlang. Ikki marta qaytaring. Shoshilmang, har bir so‘zni aniq talaffuz qiling.
scenes.say: Did you like it? I didn't work yesterday. What did you do last night?
scenes.say_uz: Sizga yoqdimi? Men kecha ishlamadim. Kecha kechqurun nima qildingiz?

scenes.title: Hozirgi va o‘tgan zamon

examples.t: I clean my room every Sunday.

scenes.say_native: Ikki zamonni solishtiramiz. Har kuni, odatda: she works. Kecha: she worked. Inkor: hozirgi zamonda she doesn’t work, o‘tgan zamonda she didn’t work. Savol: does she work, did she work. Qaysi zamon ekanligini vaqt so‘zi ko‘rsatadi: every day, usually, always — hozirgi zamon; yesterday, last week, ago — o‘tgan zamon.
scenes.say: She works every day. She worked yesterday.
scenes.say_uz: U har kuni ishlaydi. U kecha ishladi.

scenes.title: Qaysi zamon?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Birinchi: u har yakshanba tennis o‘ynaydi. Ikkinchi: u kecha tennis o‘ynadi. Uchinchi: u kecha kechqurun qo‘ng‘iroq qilmadi. To‘rtinchi: siz o‘tgan hafta ularni ko‘rgani bordingizmi? Vaqt so‘zlariga qarab zamonni aniqlang.
scenes.say: Choose the correct form. One. He plays or played tennis every Sunday. Two. He plays or played tennis yesterday. Three. She called or didn't call last night. Four. Did you visit them last week?
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Bir. U har yakshanba tennis o‘ynaydi. Ikki. U kecha tennis o‘ynadi. Uch. U kecha kechqurun qo‘ng‘iroq qilmadi. To‘rt. Siz o‘tgan hafta ularni ko‘rgani bordingizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — plays, every Sunday, hozirgi zamon, he bilan s. Ikkinchi — played, yesterday, o‘tgan zamon. Uchinchi — didn’t call, last night o‘tgan zamon va inkor, fe’l oddiy shaklda. To‘rtinchi — did you visit, last week o‘tgan zamon, savolda did. Vaqt so‘zi doimo yo‘l ko‘rsatadi, unga qarang.
scenes.say: Plays. Played. Didn't call. Did you visit?
scenes.say_uz: Plays. Played. Didn't call. Did you visit?

scenes.title: Oldinga nazar: noto‘g‘ri fe’llar
scenes.say_native: Bitta muhim ogohlantirish. Bugungi qoida muntazam fe’llar uchun. Ingliz tilida eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan ba’zi fe’llar boshqacha o‘zgaradi: go — went, have — had, see — saw. Ular noto‘g‘ri, ya’ni irregular fe’llar deyiladi va ularni keyingi darsda o‘rganamiz. Hozircha “goed” yoki “haved” demang. Bu shakllar mavjud emas, ularni ko‘pchilik bolalar ham boshida shunday aytadi.
scenes.say: Go, went. Have, had. See, saw. Next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Go, went. Have, had. See, saw. Keyingi darsda!

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: kecha nima qildingiz?
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Kechangiz haqida besh gap ayting. Kamida uchta regular fe’l, bitta inkor gap va bitta vaqt so‘zi ishlating. Masalan: I worked in the morning. I cleaned my room. I didn’t watch TV. Hozir baland ovozda gapiring, keyin yodingizda qolganini yozib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Say five sentences about yesterday. Use one negative sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Kechangiz haqida besh gap ayting. Bitta inkor gap ishlating.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: In the evening I cooked and called my mother.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: Yesterday I worked from nine to five. In the evening I cleaned my room and cooked dinner. Then I called my mother. We talked for an hour. I didn’t watch TV. Siz ham o‘z gapingizni tekshiring: har bir fe’lga ed qo‘shdingizmi, inkorda didn’t va oddiy fe’l ishlatdingizmi, imlo qoidalari to‘g‘rimi? Bo‘lsa, siz o‘tgan zamonni o‘zlashtirdingiz.
scenes.say: Yesterday I worked. I cleaned my room. I called my mother. I didn't watch TV.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha men ishladim. Xonamni tozaladim. Onamga qo‘ng‘iroq qildim. Televizor ko‘rmadim.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars xulosasi
board: fe’l + ed (like → liked, study → studied, stop → stopped)
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Muntazam fe’llarning o‘tgan zamoni: fe’l plus ed, hamma shaxsga bir xil. Imlo: e bilan tugasa d, undosh plus y bo‘lsa ied, qisqa fe’lda ikkilanish. Talaffuz: t, d yoki id. Vaqt so‘zlari: yesterday, last week, two days ago. Inkor: didn’t va oddiy fe’l. Savol: did, ega, oddiy fe’l. Siz bugun o‘tmish haqida gapirishning poydevorini qo‘ydingiz!
scenes.say: Verb plus ed. Didn't plus verb. Did plus subject plus verb. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Fe’l plus ed. Didn't plus fe’l. Did plus ega plus fe’l. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: kecha nima qilganingiz haqida sakkizta gap yozing. Ularning ichida kamida bitta inkor gap, bitta savol va kamida ikkita vaqt so‘zi bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni — barcha regular fe’llarda ed to‘g‘ri yozilgan va didn’t yoki did dan keyin oddiy fe’l qo‘llangan. Keyingi darsda o‘tgan zamon: noto‘g‘ri fe’llarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: write eight sentences about yesterday. Next time we learn irregular verbs.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: kecha haqida sakkiz gap yozing. Keyingi darsda noto‘g‘ri fe’llarni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: Kecha nima qilganingiz haqida 8 ta gap yozing: kamida bitta inkor, bitta savol va ikkita vaqt so‘zi bo‘lsin. Mezon: barcha regular fe’llarda -ed to‘g‘ri yozilgan va didn’t/did dan keyin oddiy fe’l ishlatilgan.

quiz.q: What is the past form of “study”?
quiz.why_uz: Undoshdan keyingi y i ga o‘zgaradi va ed qo‘shiladi: study — studied.

quiz.q: What is the past form of “stop”?
quiz.why_uz: Qisqa fe’lda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: stop — stopped.
Last night o‘tgan zamonni bildiradi, shuning uchun watched.
Didn’t dan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda: didn’t watch.
Yesterday o‘tgan zamon, shuning uchun savolda did ishlatiladi.
“Oldin” ma’nosida ago ishlatiladi va davrdan keyin keladi: two years ago.

options: I called her in last week.
I called her at last week.
quiz.why_uz: Last week oldidan predlog kerak emas.
T dan keyin ed alohida bo‘g‘in bo‘ladi: wanted — /ˈwɒntɪd/.
K jarangsiz tovush, shuning uchun ed /t/ deb o‘qiladi: worked — /wɜːkt/.
O‘tgan zamonda savol so‘zidan keyin did: Where did she work?
